item.title: Bludit Flat File CMS
item.description:
Pi Lab is powered by Bludit.

Bludit is an amazing Flat File CMS. There is no database to configure!

With a full featured plugin and theme system the ability to fully customize your setup is truly amazing. It is SEO friendly. It supports Markdown and HTML for your content and includes a Markdown Editor and WYSIWYG Editor.

If you are looking for a powerful and lean CMS I highly recommend Bludit.

Checkout Bludit

item.title: Pi-hole is amazing!
item.description:
If you are tired of being bombarded by all of the internet advertisements online then you should give Pi-hole a try.

It is super simple to setup and get running. It not only blocks advertisements but also many sites that you might prefer your kids not see. With the ability to white-list or black-lists sites you can really fine tune things to your needs.

Since the blocking is done at the network level you are able to even block in-app advertising.

I recommend setting things up to cover your entire network. This requires a minor change in your router to point your DNS to the IP of the Pi-hole. It is nice to know that your entire network is instantly covered.

So far I haven't seen any negative effects or running Pi-hole. Our connection speeds have not suffered and no one in our home has had any issues with things getting blocked that shouldn't.

Checkout Pi-hole
